title: Beri Contraster
description: Beri Contraster is the portfolio of Muhammad Zubair, OSCP & CPTS certified. Penetration testing services, detailed CVE research, and hands-on vulnerable labs.

title: Penetration Testing & Security Assessment Services
description: Independent web, API, cloud, Active Directory, and network security testing by Muhammad Zubair. Clear scope, validated findings, and practical remediation.

title: Web Application & API Penetration Testing
description: Assess authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, and business logic in your web applications and APIs. Manual testing with evidence and remediation guidance.

title: Cloud Security Testing & IAM Assessment
description: Investigate cloud IAM permissions, exposed resources, configuration weaknesses, and attack paths. Get a scoped assessment and prioritized hardening guidance.

title: Active Directory Penetration Testing
description: Find privilege escalation and lateral movement paths across your Active Directory environment. Assess permissions, trusts, and identity controls with clear evidence.

title: Internal & External Network Penetration Testing
description: Assess external exposure, internal infrastructure, and network segmentation. Validate exploitable weaknesses and understand the attack paths to critical systems.

description: Meet Muhammad Zubair (BeriContraster), an OSCP and CPTS certified penetration tester who builds security labs and tests web, API, cloud, and Active Directory systems.
